verses.1: Now, go ahead and be rich! But remember, you will suffer greatly because of all the hardships that will come your way.
verses.2: Your wealth was increased, and your clothes became more luxurious.
verses.3: Your gold and silver will be destroyed; their dust will become food for your flesh. It will devour your bodies, just as fire destroys things in the depths of time.
verses.4: See, the wages of those workers who have been taken away from your land are being sung by those who are not your people. And the cattle of those who work in the fields of Lord Savath are being taken away as well.
verses.5: You have scattered yourself upon the earth and have destroyed everything; you have filled your hearts with sorrow on the day of destruction.
verses.6: You have condemned and violated justice. Won’t you stand against this?
verses.7: So, wait patiently, brothers, until the Lord appears. For the farmer, after waiting long, finally receives the precious fruits of the earth. He waits patiently until he can harvest and enjoy them.
verses.8: Also, you should be patient. Strengthen your hearts, for the Lord’s presence is near.
verses.9: Do not be too harsh on each other, brothers, so that you won’t judge others. Look, the judge is standing right outside the doors.
verses.10: Let us take as an example, brothers, the wickedness and long-suffering of those prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
verses.11: We rejoice in those who remain behind; you have heard of their patience. You also know that the Lord’s end is very difficult and full of challenges.
verses.12: First of all, my brothers, do not swear either by heaven or by earth or by anything else. But let your “Nai Nai” and “Ou O” be your only oaths, so that you will not be subject to judgment.
verses.13: Is there anyone among you who is evil? I pray for them. Is there anyone who is good-natured? Then let them be saved.
verses.14: Is there anyone among you who is weak? I invite the elders of the church. They will speak to him, and they will address him with the honorable title of “Lord”.
verses.15: And the desire for faith will save the sinner. The Lord will also strengthen him. Even if he is considered a sinner, he will still be saved.
verses.16: Therefore, you must confess each other’s sins and ask for forgiveness for one another, so that you may be reconciled. The desire for justice is very important when it is acted upon.
verses.17: Elias was a person who shared our same feelings. He prayed for himself not to be lost, and he indeed wasn’t lost on this earth for three years and one month.
verses.18: And once again, it was summoned. Then the sky revealed it, and the earth split open to reveal its fruit.
verses.19: Brothers, if anyone among you becomes distracted from the truth and turns back,
verses.20: I see that when you return from your sinful journey, he will save your soul from death and cover a multitude of sins.
